source_rows.name: Total aflatoxins
source_rows.scope: Cereal/cereal products, dried figs, arecanut, nuts, oilseeds/oil, pulses, spices/spice mixes, or food products containing listed articles
source_rows.decision: Actual finished commodity or proven listed ingredients and correct processed form required.

source_rows.name: Aflatoxin B1
source_rows.scope: Cereals, dried figs, arecanut, nuts, oilseeds/oil, pulses, spices/spice mixes, and food containing them
source_rows.decision: Determine whether the actual marketed article or verified ingredients meet one of the listed categories.

source_rows.name: Aflatoxin M1
source_rows.scope: Milk (liquid), skimmed milk powder, whole milk powder
source_rows.decision: Milk-derived, coconut-milk-named, colostrum or composite products are not automatically one of these finished forms.

source_rows.name: Ochratoxin A
source_rows.scope: Wheat, wheat bran, rye, barley, coffee
source_rows.decision: Named commodity does not automatically encompass its compounded beverage, powder, premix or processed derivatives.

source_rows.name: Patulin
source_rows.scope: Apple juice; apple juice used as an ingredient in other beverages
source_rows.decision: Whole/frozen fruit is not apple juice; ingredient and final-beverage identity both require documentary evidence.

source_rows.name: Deoxynivalenol
source_rows.decision: Do not equate any cereal, generic grain flour or multi-ingredient premix with the named commodities.

source_rows.name: Agaric acid
source_rows.decision: Require actual mushroom ingredient and finished-recipe evidence, not a generic fungi or premix label.

source_rows.name: Hydrocyanic acid
source_rows.scope: Nougat, marzipan/similar products, canned stone fruits, confectionery, stone fruit juices, sago/cassava/tapioca/Manihot flours and products, alcoholic beverages
source_rows.decision: Verify the finished confectionery/juice/plant-flour identity; arrowroot is not named cassava or tapioca.
